filename.meaning: Nonempty filename equal to its final path component.

total_size.meaning: Total byte length for the preallocated spool.

target_dir.meaning: Target directory; the resulting target must be under the ingress root, have an existing parent and not be a symlink.

chunk_size.meaning: Optional chunk size in bytes; absent or null uses 4 MiB.

x-caduceus-document.meaning: Required nonblank document identity carried in the HTTP header, not the JSON body.

x-caduceus-attendance.meaning: Optional attendance HTTP header for the document; otherwise the upload policy admits an open or PIN-authorized start.

upload_id.meaning: New UUID identifying the in-memory session.

ok.meaning: False on an explicit handler refusal; the success body contains upload_id.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: A handler refusal signal; the successful handler body does not supply this field.
